product: ANT(3'')-IIa is a aminoglycoside nucleotidyltransferase identified in Acinetobacter spp. via horizontal gene transfer mechanisms.
Tet(B) is a tetracycline efflux protein expressed in many Gram-negative bacteria. It confers resistance to tetracycline doxycycline and minocycline but not tigecycline.

APH(6)-Id is an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids integrative conjugative elements and chromosomal genomic islands in K. pneumoniae Salmonella spp. E. coli Shigella flexneri Providencia alcalifaciens Pseudomonas spp. V. cholerae Edwardsiella tarda Pasteurella multocida and Aeromonas bestiarum.
APH(3'')-Ib is an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids transposons integrative conjugative elements and chromosomes in Enterobacteriaceae and Pseudomonas spp.
LpsB is involved in lipopolysaccharide synthesis. It confers intrinsic resistance to colistin and other peptide antibiotics.
OXA-23 is a beta-lactamase found in A. baumannii.
Sul1 is a sulfonamide resistant dihydropteroate synthase of Gram-negative bacteria. It is linked to other resistance genes of class 1 integrons.
QacEdelta1 is a resistance gene conferring resistance to antiseptics. It is different from QacE only at the 3'-terminus.
AAC(6')-Iaf is an aminoglycoside acetyltransferase encoded by plasmids and integrons in P. aeruginosa.
TEM-12 is an extended-spectrum beta-lactamase found in Klebsiella oxytoca.
Expression of abaF in E. coli resulted in increased resistance to fosfomycin.
OXA-66 is a beta-lactamase found in A. baumannii.
AdeC is the outer membrane factor of the AdeABC multidrug efflux complex. It can be replaced by other outer membrane channels and is not essential for antibiotic resistance.
AdeB is the multidrug transporter of the adeABC efflux system.
AdeA is the membrane fusion protein of the multidrug efflux complex AdeABC.
AdeR is a positive regulator of AdeABC efflux system. AdeR inactivation leads to susceptibility to aminoglycoside antibiotics.
AdeS is a sensor kinase in the AdeRS regulatory system of AdeABC. It is essential for AdeABC expression.
AbaQ is an MFS transporter mainly involved in the extrusion of quinolone-type drugs in A. baumannii.
AdeN is a repressor of AdeIJK a RND-type efflux pump in Acinetobacter baumannii. Its inactivation increases expression of AdeJ.

AmvA has 14 alpha-helical transmembrane segments qualifying it as a member of the DHA2 transporter family of the major facilitator superfamily (MFS). When AmvA was expressed in E. coli  the cells had at least four-fold decreased susceptibility to erythromycin acridine orange acriflavine deoxycholate and methyl viologen. AmvA from the AC0037 strain of A. baumannii was tested.
mphE is a macrolide phosphotransferase and resistance gene identified on a plasmid pRSB105.

MsrE is an ABC-F subfamily protein expressed to Klebsiella pneumoniae that confers resistance to erythromycin and streptogramin B antibiotics. It is associated with plasmid DNA. It is also 100% identical to ABC-F type ribosomal protection protein Msr(E) which is in multiple species.

ArmA is a 16S rRNA methyltransferase that targets mature or nearly mature 30S subunits. It transfers a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to N7-G1405 of the 16S rRNA an aminoglycoside binding site.
Sul1 is a sulfonamide resistant dihydropteroate synthase of Gram-negative bacteria. It is linked to other resistance genes of class 1 integrons.
QacEdelta1 is a resistance gene conferring resistance to antiseptics. It is different from QacE only at the 3'-terminus.
ANT(3'')-Ia is an aminoglycoside nucleotidyltransferase gene encoded by plasmids transposons integrons in Enterobacteriaceae A. baumannii P. aeruginosa and Vibrio cholerae.
catB8 is a plasmid or integron-encoded variant of the cat gene found in Klebsiella pneumoniae Salmonella typhi and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
AAC(6')-Ib7 is a plasmid-encoded aminoglycoside acetyltransferase in E. cloacae and C. freundii.

APH(3')-Ia is a transposon-encoded aminoglycoside phosphotransferase in E. coli and S. enterica. It is identical at the protein sequence to APH(3')-Ic an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids transposons and genomic islands in K. pneumoniae A. baumannii S. marcescens Corynebacterium spp. Photobacterium spp. and Citrobacter spp.
AbeS in an efflux pump of the SMR family of transporters found in Acinetobacter baumannii.
AdeL is a regulator of AdeFGH in Acinetobacter baumannii. AdeL mutations are associated with AdeFGH overexpression and multidrug resistance.
AdeG is the inner membrane transporter of the AdeFGH multidrug efflux complex.
AdeF is the membrane fusion protein of the multidrug efflux complex AdeFGH.
AdeH is the outer membrane channel protein of the AdeFGH multidrug efflux complex.
ADC-31 is a beta-lactamase found in Acinetobacter baumannii.
AdeI is the membrane fusion protein of the AdeIJK multidrug efflux complex.
AdeJ is a RND efflux protein that acts as the inner membrane transporter of the AdeIJK efflux complex. It has 57% identity with E. coli AcrB.
AdeK is the outer membrane factor protein in the adeIJK multidrug efflux complex.
